transcript.content: Hello. I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Well, occupational health at work sent me in. They're saying my weight is dangerously low for someone who runs presses and does metal fabrication all day. 

I... I don't really see it that way. I honestly thought I was just getting leaner and more disciplined, to be honest. But they insisted I come see you, so here I am.
During the periods when you are maintaining this low weight, do you ever engage in episodes of binge eating followed by self-induced vomiting or the misuse of laxatives or diuretics?
No, I don't do any of that. I've never... I don't make myself throw up or take laxatives or anything like that. And I definitely don't binge eat. I just keep a really strict handle on what I take in.
